title: Dopamine D1 Receptor (DRD1)
mechanism: Selective D1 antagonism attenuates hyperactive striatal direct-pathway tic output while sparing D2 receptors, eliminating extrapyramidal symptoms (EPS) and tardive dyskinesia.
